name: Mengdeng Biye
source:
The elder sister of Fancia Dream and the former Captain of the Arborangers. It is said that she is the strongest Illuminator of her generation, but she suffered a permanent leg injury during a mission and unfortunately had to resign and return home. Because of her own experience, she has been hindering her sister, Fancia, from becoming an Arboranger.

[spoiler]In reality, former Arboranger leader Mildia Dream unexpectedly died when going out on a mission.[/spoiler]
